title: PipelineHealthRecord
description: Composite pipeline health snapshot (pipeline-health-record/v1). Rolls up SLA metrics (end-to-end latency + per-stage success rates), per-queue backlog status, active alerts (validation failures, backlog buildup, latency SLO breaches, canary failures), and the result of automated schema-evolution canary testing against wasmagent-protocol updates. Single source of truth shared by trace-pipeline (emitter) and wasmagent-ops (consumer).

overall_status.description: Derived rollup: healthy = no alerts and SLOs met; degraded = warning alerts or near-breach; unhealthy = critical alert or SLO breach.

sla.description: Latency and per-stage success-rate measurements for this snapshot's window.

backlogs.description: Per-queue backlog status. Queues whose breaches_threshold is true SHOULD also appear as backlog_buildup alerts.

alerts.description: Active alerts fired in this snapshot's window. validation_failure covers schema/validation rejections; backlog_buildup covers queue depth/age breaches.

stage.description: Optional pipeline stage/queue the alert is scoped to.

count.description: Number of occurrences in the window.

canary.description: Result of automated canary testing of schema evolution: the pipeline re-runs its validation fixtures against a candidate wasmagent-protocol update before adoption, so a breaking schema change fails here instead of in production.

protocol_version.description: The wasmagent-protocol package version the canary validated against (e.g. '0.1.7').

status.description: pass = all sampled fixtures still validate under the candidate protocol; fail = at least one broke (also surfaces a canary_failure alert); skipped = canary not run.

schemas_checked.description: Number of canonical schemas exercised by the canary.

failures.description: Per-fixture canary failures. SHOULD be non-empty iff status is 'fail'.

fixture.description: Path/id of the fixture that regressed.
